events.title: Brisbane Open House 2026
events.description: A city-wide program opening dozens of significant buildings and heritage sites for free public tours and talks, exploring Brisbane's architecture, design, and history. Continues into Monday with selected open houses and activities.

events.title: Queensland Performing Arts Centre Daytime Programs
events.location: Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Brisbane
events.description: A daytime arts program at QPAC including talks, short performances, and foyer activations, with scheduled sessions at 12:15 PM and 5:30 PM, suitable for arts and theatre enthusiasts.

events.title: Meditation and Mindset Workshop
events.location: Pullman Brisbane King George Square, Brisbane City
events.description: An in-person personal development workshop spanning July 25–26, focusing on meditation practice, mindset skills, and stress reduction for adults in a small group setting.

events.title: Le Festival: Brisbane French Festival 2026
events.description: The first day of a three-day French cultural festival at Roma Street Parkland, featuring markets, food and wine stalls, lifestyle workshops, French language and culture talks, and community social spaces.

events.title: Le Festival: Brisbane French Festival 2026
events.description: The second day of Brisbane's French cultural festival, with ongoing gastronomy, artisan products, cultural experiences, family activities, and community interaction in Roma Street Parkland.

events.title: Le Festival: Brisbane French Festival 2026
events.description: The final day of the French cultural festival, offering a vibrant evening social atmosphere, with food, wine, demonstrations, and family-friendly activities in the parklands.
